t: This is Stockwell tube station, in the London Borough of Lambeth. It is served by the Northern line and the Victoria line, and sits in fare zone 2. It is also a place of sad memory. On the day after the failed bombing attempts of 22 July 2005, Jean Charles de Menezes, a Brazilian man, was shot dead here by the Metropolitan Police. He had been wrongly identified as one of the fugitives. He was entirely innocent. Take a moment to remember him.
